name: omp-kenari
description: Kenari ID provider for the omp coding agent: live model catalogue plus the Jev System One judge role

discoveryEnabled.description: Import the Kenari chat catalogue from https://kenari.id/v1/models when KENARI_API_KEY is set.

filterPayPerUse.description: Hide Kenari models that are neither free nor included in a subscription plan.

autoJudge.description: Route the judge model role to Kenari's Jev System One endpoint when no judge role is configured.

toolsEnabled.description: Register the kenari_search, kenari_fetch, kenari_embed and kenari_rerank tools.

startupNotice.description: Show a one-line Kenari account summary when a session starts.

scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run smoke
